group.label: Memoirs · Journal of a Newbie Officer

lines.text: The first Ark sealing has been completed. The Goddess Squad has done it again.
Without a single casualty, no less.
The Commander and the Goddess Squad have turned the tide of the war.
When was it that I first heard the rumors about the Goddess Squad? Back then, I never imagined a day like this would come.
But despite all of their accomplishments, humanity's descent into the Ark is ultimately a defeat.
For now, it may seem as though humanity is being shut away inside the Ark, but one day, we will reclaim the surface.
As for when that day will come, I don't know.
Even if it isn't me, I believe someone will be inspired by him. Someone who dares to dream will become a commander and carry on his will.
And on the day humanity reclaims the surface, the Commander leading the Goddess Squad will be standing at the forefront.
